title: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Alignment auditing of frontier models increasingly relies on LLM auditors to surface undesirable behaviors at scale, but current automated auditors can struggle with coherent investigation and audit realism. In this work, we improve LLM auditors with reinforcement learning. In our best training environment, the policy investigates target models that potentially possess hidden behaviors planted via their system prompt. An LLM judge, which knows whether the target has a hidden behavior, holistically compares the policy's investigation to a reference investigation to determine the reward. With systematic ablations, we find that pairwise rewards yield more robust training compared to pointwise rewards, and that adding targets without planted behaviors helps maintain a low false positive rate. translated_title: 通过强化学习训练对齐审计员
translated_abstract: 前沿模型的对齐审计日益依赖大型语言模型审计员来大规模揭示不良行为，但当前自动化审计员在连贯调查和审计真实性方面存在不足。在本工作中，我们利用强化学习改进LLM审计员。在我们最佳的训练环境中，策略模型调查可能通过系统提示隐藏行为的潜在目标模型。一个知晓目标是否具有隐藏行为的LLM评判者，综合比较策略调查与参考调查以确定奖励。通过系统性消融实验，我们发现成对奖励相比点式奖励能产生更稳健的训练，而加入无隐藏行为的目标有助于维持较低误报率。训练提升了针对带有隐藏行为目标的调查质量，以及未修改生产模型中令人担忧行为被揭示的比率。
tldr: 本文提出利用强化学习训练LLM审计员，通过成对奖励和混合目标策略，显著提升了对前沿模型隐藏行为的调查质量与低误报率。
en_tdlr: This work improves LLM auditors via reinforcement learning with pairwise rewards and mixed targets, enhancing investigation quality against hidden behaviors while maintaining a low false positive rate.
